games.name: Break an Egg
games.note: HAS A SERVER-SIDE MOVEMENT CHECK AND IT KICKS - an early build warped with CFrame and the account was disconnected with 'Movement exploit detected. (Error Code: 267)'. A client string sweep came back clean and proved nothing, because a server-side detector has no client code to find. The script walks with Humanoid:MoveTo and writes CFrame only for rotation. carry-and-place with a mining step in front. PickaxeSwing:FireServer(egg) is the damage call and the CLIENT raycasts along the character's LookVector, so the root part has to FACE the egg - and the stand-off must scale with the egg's Radius attribute (a Giant is 6.46, so a fixed 6-stud offset parks you inside it and every swing misses). Hits = ceil(hp/PickaxePower), hp 6/20/70/500/3000/12000/45000 per size. Eggs carry SizeTier and Mutation as attributes BEFORE they break, so targets are picked for free. MoneyLog10 is the exact money oracle; leaderstats has no money. BuyPickaxe skips the ladder. Placing is RequestPlaceItem(x, z, rot) in PEN-LOCAL coords; selling is RequestSell('Equipped'), which only ever touches the animal in hand but IS position gated at the vendor (46 studs did nothing, 6 studs sold). The pen is one-way - no prompt and no remote takes a placed animal back - so the last slots are saved for upgrades and the rest of the catch is sold. RequestBaseUpgrade() adds 4 slots for $1M to a ceiling of 26. plr.CarryCount is a zone flag, not ownership

games.name: [TRADE] Beat the Anime Boss!
games.note: FREE. Roll a boss onto your plot, beat it, it drops an anime unit into a 25-slot chest, place the good ones on the six plot slots where they deal the damage and pay the income. Vanilla Roblox, 59 named remotes, every config require-able. THE CLICK IS NOT THE LEVER: AttackBoss('Click') is server-capped at ~1 hit/s and the game's own AutoClickerController already saturates it (50 calls at 10/s produced 5 damage echoes against 4 in a silent window) - the damage comes from the PLACED UNITS, so unit quality is the only thing that moves the economy. A unit's worth is computed before it is touched from CharacterConfig.GetInfo (AttackDamage/MoneyPerSecond over 163 characters, 33 rarity tiers) x MutationConfig DamageBoost (Normal 1 ... Omega 8) x PetLevelConfig level curve, validated against the live billboard to the digit. RARITY BEATS LEVEL and that is the whole script: a level 1 Epic measured 4.2K DMG against a level 24 Rare at 1.3K. The chest cap of 25 is a hard stop - a full chest blocks every new drop - so pruning runs before placement. Upgrading a unit is NOT UpgradePet:FireServer(uid) (a dead end that moves nothing); it is the slot SurfaceGui button's MouseButton1Click (Activated has 0 connections, the handler is in an Actor VM). BuyUpgrade:FireServer('<StatKey>') takes one of Summoner/Luck/Damage/AutoRoll/Slots/RespawnDelay/WalkSpeed. Money is firetouchinterest on Plot.Claimer.Hitbox and is not position gated (verified from 41 studs). Codes go through Communication:FireServer('RedeemCode', CODE). WARNING: bridge.py spy BREAKS THIS GAME - with the FireServer hook installed the game's own rolling and chest collecting silently stop working

games.note: carry-and-place plot income with the progression moved into JUMP POWER: squat on the barbell for Jump XP, Jump Power gates which area you may enter, steal an egg, carry it home, place it in the pen and it hatches into an animal paying cash per second. A near relative of stealegg but with NO anti-cheat (sweeps over 5-7k live functions found nothing), so plain CFrame warping is used. The trap that makes the whole farm look broken: while the player attribute IsSquatting is true the egg CollectPrompt silently never pays out, so StopSquattingRequest has to be fired first, every time. Starting to squat is position gated and needs a Heartbeat pin; continuing is not revalidated, so the travel legs are free training. Never burst SquatTrainingRequest - the client already fires it ~4x/s and a flood makes the server refuse training for 40-60s in silence
games.detect: local rs = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage') local r = rs:FindFirstChild('Remotes') if not r then return false end local m = game.Workspace:FindFirstChild('Map') return r:FindFirstChild('StopSquattingRequest') ~= nil and r:FindFirstChild('PlaceEggRequest') ~= nil and r:FindFirstChild('SquatTrainingRequest') ~= nil and m ~= nil and m:FindFirstChild('Stages') ~= nil
